description: SLS 3.6 MSS invalidation, reached with mss_then_reclaim_series: within 10 candles of an MSS, a close back beyond the pre-MSS extreme marks it low_quality. Each mutation breaks the rule, either edge of its window, its anchor, its timing or its once-only fact. The two edge mutations bite on a single reclaim delay each (1 and 10, 11 for the widened window), so those three are caught by test_the_window_edges_are_exact, which pins each delay, rather than by chance draws. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/mss_invalidation.json

mutations.name: the candle straight after the MSS cannot invalidate it
the invalidation window is nine candles, not ten
the invalidation window is eleven candles, not ten
the reclaim is judged on the next candle's close
the watch stays armed after it fires, so one reclaim invalidates again and again
